regime_context: Canada/TSX shows Big Banks as the dominant theme with high durability (0.74) and full breadth, but crowded (z=1.36). The absolute-trend gate is effective (gate_helps=True) with broad eligibility (69% of themes). Rotation is broad, no one-narrative market, no confirmed handoff. Momentum ranks are a focus lens only; the one validated edge is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate. Past calls: small sample (n=6), hit rate 83%, direction accuracy 67%. This supports low-conviction directional leans, not predictions.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the clear momentum leader with strong durability (0.74) and full breadth, and they remain eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which has historically reduced drawdowns in this market. Crowding flags a sizing caution but not a fade; the trend structure still supports staying positioned. The lean is on staying with the eligible trend, not on momentum rank predicting returns.
evidence: Rank: #1, momentum score 1.518 (focus lens, not alpha)
Eligibility: true (above absolute-trend gate, gate_helps valid)
Durability: 0.74 (mixed Hurst but high durability bar)
theses.dissent: Crowded positioning may trigger sharp de-grossing if macro backdrops shift, and the zero rank-IC means there is no reliable momentum edge.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO loses absolute-trend eligibility in the next weekly detector update (i.e., crosses below its trend gate).

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals are the clear runner-up, eligible and not crowded, with moderate durability (0.51). They offer an alternative to the crowded leader without suffering trend-gate risk. Low breadth (0.222) warns that the move is narrow, but the absolute-trend gate still provides drawdown control, making an overweight lean plausible.
evidence: Rank: #2, challenger to leader Big Banks
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth and mixed trend quality suggest the leadership may be fragile; a reversal in copper prices could quickly erode the absolute trend.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 40-week absolute-trend gate (loses eligibility) and the 20-day return turns negative.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are ineligible (below the absolute-trend gate) with low durability (0.30) and a negative momentum score. The trend gate’s historical benefit suggests underweighting to avoid continued draw-downs. This is not a fade call but a risk-avoidance lean based on the one validated edge.
theses.dissent: A sudden geopolitical shock or gold price spike could reverse the downtrend rapidly, making the underweight painful.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners theme becomes eligible in the next detector update (XGD.TO closes above its absolute-trend gate) and durability_bar rises above 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
